This graph presents the GDP growth rate of Bangladesh from 2006 to 2015. The data presented in the graph shows that there has been ups and downs in the GDP growth rate. In 2006, it was 5.95, but it rose to the highest ever growth in 2007 which was 6.63, but there was a gradual decline to 2012, the rates were 6.43, 6.19, 5.75 and 5.57, the lowest ever, respectively in 2008, 2009, 2011, and 2012. In the next two years, there was a significant development. It rose up to 6.46 and 6.52 respectively in 2013 and 2014. Again there was a fall in 2014 and 2015, and the rates were 6.01 and 6.12 respectively. Thus growth rate has been fluctuating in the last 10 years.
